🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's GPS isn't just clever tech; it's a daily dance with Einstein's mind-bending theories of relativity!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 GPS satellites zoom around Earth at incredible speeds.
🔹 Due to relativity, time ticks slightly faster for them than on Earth.
🔹 This tiny difference, millionths of a second, would throw your GPS off by miles daily.
🔹 Without Einstein's equations, your navigation wouldn't be spot-on!
